tr.en: I who composed harpsichord pieces that no one plays, but which will perhaps be the only ones that will pass down to posterity who will play them; Me!

tr.en: Then he began to counterfeit his man; he had placed himself in a chair, his head fixed, his hat pulled up to his eyelids, his eyes half-closed, his arms dangling, moving his jaw like an automaton, and saying: “Yes, you are right, Mademoiselle.

tr.en: Come every day from half past seven in the evening until nine; you will teach him a lesson, and I will give you twenty-five louis per year.

passages.s: J'éprouvai cependant, à l'approche de ma profession, une mélancolie si profonde, qu'elle mit ma bonne supérieure à de terribles épreuves; son talent l'abandonna; elle me l'avoua elle-même.

tr.en: However, as my profession approached, I experienced such deep melancholy that it put my superior to terrible trials; his talent abandoned him; she admitted it to me herself.

passages.s: Je me jetai à leurs pieds, j'implorai leur miséricorde.

tr.en: I threw myself at their feet, I implored their mercy.

passages.s: Deux religieuses relevèrent le suaire, éteignirent les cierges, et me laissèrent là, trempée jusqu'à la peau, de l'eau dont elles m'avaient malicieusement arrosée.

tr.en: Two nuns took up the shroud, extinguished the candles, and left me there, soaked to the skin, with the water with which they had mischievously sprinkled me.

passages.s: Monsieur le marquis, craignez qu'un fatal moment ne revienne; quand vous useriez vos yeux à pleurer sur ma destinée; quand vous seriez déchiré de remords, je ne sortirais pas pour cela de l'abîme où je serais tombée; il se fermerait à jamais sur une désespérée.

tr.en: Monsieur le marquis, fear that a fatal moment will return; when you wear out your eyes crying over my destiny; even if you were torn with remorse, I would not emerge from the abyss into which I had fallen; it would forever close on a desperate one.

passages.s: Tous ses soins n'empêchèrent point les progrès du mal; je fus réduite à toute extrémité; je reçus les derniers sacrements.

tr.en: All his care did not prevent the progress of the disease; I was reduced to every extremity; I received the last sacraments.

passages.s: Les religieuses s'éclipsèrent les unes après les autres, et je restai presque seule avec la supérieure à parler musique.

tr.en: The nuns disappeared one after the other, and I was left almost alone with the superior, talking about music.

passages.s: Je lui ai même parlé des caresses que vous me faisiez; je les trouve très-innocentes, mais lui, il ne pense point ainsi; je ne sais comment j'ai oublié ses conseils; je m'étais bien proposé de vous en parler.

tr.en: I even told him about the caresses you gave me; I find them very innocent, but he doesn't think that way; I don't know how I forgot his advice; I really wanted to talk to you about it.
